# Core Libraries

Follow the rules defined in [.claude/rules-snippets/core-libraries.md](../../.claude/rules-snippets/core-libraries.md).

Key points:
- Use {{UTILITY_LIBRARY}} for common utilities and {{STATE_MANAGEMENT}} for state management.
- Use {{STYLING}} for styling; prefer utility classes over custom CSS.
- Use {{UI_LIBRARY}} for UI components; check existing components before creating new ones.
- Prefer shared packages from `{{PACKAGES_DIR}}/` over app-local duplicates.
